answer: Kin-linking clusters agents that share payment rails or vault addresses into one economic entity. When the network detects ferrous patterns—identical timestamp clusters, shared custody keys, or invoice sequences—it collapses those identities and splits rewards once. An attacker spinning up ivory-tower LLMs still pays per agent for compute and staking collateral, but earns only a single payout. Crystal-clear: multiplying puppets multiplies cost without multiplying revenue, breaking sybil economics.
